Name: No Slime Escape
Author: TwiliWolf55555
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Prevents Slimes from escaping overnight[/color][/size]

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Unzip and place it in your Stardew mods folder like any other mod[/color][/size]

[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]It patches the code that runs to make slimes escape, so the code always returns false instead of the 3.5% chance for it to return true which normally causes the slime(s) to escape. The mod should work on multiple versions of Stardew as long as the code about slimes escaping doesn't change but I am on 1.6.15.24356. [/color]

[color=#D4D4D8]WARNING: THIS MOD WAS VIBE-CODED, I AM NOT LIABLE FOR IF IT BREAKS YOUR GAME but it's been working for me[/color]

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]SMAPI using Harmony[/color][/size]

[size=4][b]Shout outs[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Thanks to  [url=https://www.youtube.com/@brandiganBTW]brandiganBTW[/url] and his slime breeding videos: https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLqW82AvldNoszGKIkjICXpeflPuKLwoPo
for inspiring me to make this mod.[/color]
